narrative.subtitle: RTU-1 curb support repair (concealed roof deck condition)
header_rows: Sample Elementary School HVAC Replacement (Sample ISD)
RFI-001; Sample Engineering, Inc. repair detail
callout_rows: $10,000.00, firm. The Engineer directed repair of a concealed roof deck condition at RTU-1.
Holding the contract completion date. No added time requested now (Section 4).
Owner Contingency ([clause]). Pays after the signed Change Order.

blocks.text: We opened the roof at RTU-1 and found no metal deck under one side of the curb. Not shown on the plans.
We stopped, left it as found, and sent RFI-001. Concealed condition ([clause]). Notice first.
Sample Engineering, Inc. (Alex Poe, PE) issued the detail: weld steel angle supports (L3x3x1/4), add new 22 gauge deck, reset the curb, reroof to match.

rows.label: A1. Steel angle and new metal deck (welder subcontractor), itemized in the attachment
A2. Reroof the area opened for the fix (roofer subcontractor), itemized in the attachment
A3. Crane, added pick for the repair (vendor estimate)
B. Contractor field labor (rates in the itemization)
B1. Working Foreman 10 hr and Working Tech 10 hr: rig and assist the weld and set the deck
B2. Working Tech 6 hr and protection material: protect the space below during hot work

blocks.text: Each A line is that firm's own price. The welder and roofer are broken out in the attachment.
We cannot set the unit until the deck is fixed. We hold the completion date and will add crews if needed.
We reserve added time only if the condition or abnormal weather still affects the date ([clause]).
Concealed condition ([clause]): notice given, not disturbed.
Reserved, only if incurred with backup: added cost to hold the date, or deck repair beyond the area shown.
Itemization. Engineer's detail. RFI-001. Welder proposal. Roofer proposal. Crane estimate.

narrative.signoff_heading: SIGN OFFS (all three sign before the changed work is billed)

itemization.intro: Subcontractor and vendor lines are each firm's own price.

blocks.text: Subcontractor firm lump. The table allocates the price into the Engineer's format: materials by item with quantity and unit cost, labor as men times hours times rate, trip on its own line.

labor: Welders: cut and weld the angle supports and set the deck

blocks.text: Pass through at the roofer's firm price. Every line foots to the total. Scope: remove the opened area down to the deck, replace insulation and cover board, and reroof to match so the roof warranty holds.
Vendor price from the crane estimate for the added pick. Trues to the actual invoice. Estimate attached.
Section B. Contractor field labor, by role

lines: Working Foreman: rig and assist the weld, set the new metal deck, and reset the curb.
Working Tech: support the welder, hand material, control the area, clean up.
Working Tech: protect the space below during hot work; protection material.

blocks.text: Labor priced at the rates shown at the top of this itemization.
